verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing says users can use AI to build reports and dashboards on labor cost trends and overtime, and shows a natural-language prompt ("Show me headcount vs plan") producing a headcount dashboard. Employees can also get instant AI answers about benefits and pay changes inside the product. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations (the risk flags are not described as AI), in-depth documentation of how the AI analytics work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
